bio: Mr. Nick is a well-known assassin vtuber who has come out of retirement in a pursuit for vendetta. No bounty can stop his journey, as he ventures through a variety of games. From simulators, to visual novels, to story driven RPS, to his own personal fondness of genre, shooters.
